part2CueCards.topic: A meal you enjoyed with other people
part2CueCards.task: Describe a meal that you enjoyed with other people.
bullets: where and when you had the meal
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain whether you would like to have a similar meal again.

idea: Chọn bữa ăn gắn với một dịp hoặc buổi gặp cụ thể
Miêu tả món ăn và không khí
Nêu cuộc trò chuyện khiến bữa ăn vui hơn

vocab.vi: món ăn vừa được chuẩn bị
hỏi thăm nhau trong bữa tối
ra về với cảm giác hài lòng

aid.grammar: Dùng quá khứ đơn kể bữa ăn và while để mô tả món ăn cùng cuộc trò chuyện diễn ra song song.
aid.sample: One meal I really enjoyed was a weekend dinner with two close friends at a small family-run restaurant. We had not seen one another for several months, so we chose a quiet table and ordered several dishes to share. There was grilled fish, fresh vegetables and a bowl of rice that had just been cooked. Passing food around made the meal feel informal, and nobody had to choose only one thing. We spent most of the evening catching up on work, family news and small plans for the coming months. One friend had recently started a new job, so we asked about the first weeks and shared a few suggestions. The restaurant was busy, but the staff did not rush us, and the conversation could continue between courses. I remember laughing when we realised that we had all made the same mistake while trying to follow a recipe at home. The food was tasty, but the company made the meal special. It was also reasonably priced, which allowed us to stay longer without worrying about the bill. I would happily have a similar dinner again because it gave us a chance to reconnect in person. It reminded me that sharing a meal can turn an ordinary weekend into a warm memory.

part3Questions.q: Why do meals play an important role in many cultures?

idea: Bữa ăn tạo dịp gặp gỡ và trò chuyện
Món ăn lưu giữ tập quán và ký ức gia đình
aid.grammar: Dùng both A and B để nêu hai vai trò của bữa ăn.
aid.sample: Meals bring people together and give them time to talk without another activity competing for attention. Food can also carry family and regional traditions, because recipes are passed down and prepared for special occasions. Offering a meal is a common way to show hospitality. Customs vary between places, but eating together can create a sense of belonging and help people mark events in a meaningful way.

part3Questions.q: Are home-cooked meals better than meals from restaurants?

idea: Ở nhà dễ chọn nguyên liệu và khẩu phần
Nhà hàng tiện và giúp thử món mới

vocab.vi: tiết kiệm thời gian chuẩn bị

aid.grammar: Mở đầu bằng it depends on và so sánh hai lựa chọn bằng whereas.
aid.sample: Neither option is always better; it depends on the situation. Home cooking lets people control ingredients and portion sizes, and it can be less expensive. Restaurants save preparation time and offer dishes that someone may not know how to make. A balanced routine could include both: home meals on ordinary days and eating out occasionally for convenience or a social event.

part3Questions.q: Should schools teach children about nutrition and cooking?

idea: Kỹ năng chọn thực phẩm hỗ trợ quyết định hằng ngày
Nấu món đơn giản giúp trẻ tự lập hơn

vocab.vi: chuẩn bị món ăn đơn giản
đưa ra lựa chọn có hiểu biết
xây dựng sự tự tin thực tế
dùng kỹ năng bếp cơ bản

aid.grammar: Dùng should include và so that để nêu nội dung học và mục đích.
aid.sample: Schools should include basic nutrition and cooking lessons so children can make informed choices later. Learning to read a food label or prepare a simple dish is practical, regardless of a student's future job. Such lessons can also explain balanced meals without making food choices feel like a test. Families remain important, but school can ensure that every child gets some basic guidance.

part3Questions.q: What can restaurants do to reduce food waste?

idea: Điều chỉnh khẩu phần và cho chọn lượng ăn
Quyên góp thực phẩm an toàn còn dư

vocab.vi: cung cấp nhiều cỡ phần ăn
lên kế hoạch hàng tồn cẩn thận
theo dõi thức ăn thừa trong bếp
quyên góp thực phẩm dư còn an toàn
bảo quản nguyên liệu đúng cách

aid.grammar: Dùng can reduce waste by + V-ing để nêu giải pháp có thể thực hiện.
aid.sample: Restaurants can reduce waste by tracking which ingredients are often left unused and planning stock more carefully. Offering different portion sizes may prevent customers from ordering more than they can eat. Where local rules allow it, safe surplus food can be donated. Staff training on storage and preparation is also useful, because preventing waste at the start is usually better than dealing with it later.

part2CueCards.topic: A journey that took longer than expected
part2CueCards.task: Describe a journey that took longer than you expected.
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain how you felt about the experience afterwards.

idea: Chọn chuyến đi có nguyên nhân trễ rõ ràng
Kể bạn xử lý việc chờ đợi thế nào
Nêu điều bạn chuẩn bị khác đi sau trải nghiệm

vocab.vi: kiểm tra lộ trình cập nhật
cập nhật tình hình cho ai đó
sự chậm trễ ngoài dự kiến
dự trù thêm thời gian di chuyển

aid.grammar: Dùng quá khứ đơn kể sự việc, past continuous mô tả việc đang diễn ra khi có thông báo.
aid.sample: A journey that took longer than I expected was a bus trip to a nearby coastal town. I travelled with a friend during a holiday weekend, when we thought leaving early would help us avoid crowds. About an hour into the trip, traffic stopped near a road construction site. We were moving only a few metres at a time, and the driver later explained that one lane had been closed. I checked an updated route on my phone and sent a message to the person meeting us. While we waited, my friend and I shared snacks and listened to a podcast. The bus eventually moved again, but we missed the time we had planned for lunch. I felt impatient at first because I had expected the trip to be simple. After a while, I accepted that the delay was beyond our control and focused on keeping the rest of the day flexible. We still enjoyed the visit and took a walk by the water before it got dark. Since then, I have tried to allow extra travel time on busy weekends and carry water or a book. The experience was inconvenient, but it taught me to plan with a little more room for surprises.

part3Questions.q: What transport problems do people commonly face in large cities?

idea: Tắc nghẽn vào giờ cao điểm
Gián đoạn dịch vụ và thiếu kết nối giữa các tuyến
aid.grammar: Dùng may face để nêu vấn đề thường gặp và especially when để chỉ hoàn cảnh.
aid.sample: People in large cities may face peak-hour congestion, overcrowded public transport and unreliable arrival times. Road maintenance or an accident can affect several routes at once. In some areas, passengers also have limited alternatives if one service is delayed. Better coordination between transport providers and clear real-time updates can help people adjust their journeys, even when the underlying problem cannot be removed immediately.

part3Questions.q: How can governments encourage people to use public transport?

idea: Tăng độ tin cậy, tần suất và kết nối tuyến
Làm việc đi lại dễ dự đoán và thuận tiện

vocab.vi: nhà ga an toàn và sạch sẽ
lựa chọn thay thế thực tế

aid.grammar: Dùng by improving + danh từ để nêu chính sách cụ thể và so that để giải thích kết quả.
aid.sample: Governments can encourage public transport by making services frequent, reliable and easy to connect. Clean, safe stations and simple ticketing reduce the small frustrations that discourage passengers. Routes should link residential areas with workplaces and essential services, so travelling without a car is a practical alternative. Fares matter too, but reliability is important because people need to trust that they will arrive on time.

part3Questions.q: What effects can tourism have on small communities?

idea: Du lịch tạo việc làm và hỗ trợ cửa hàng địa phương
Lượng khách lớn gây áp lực lên giao thông, nhà ở và môi trường

vocab.vi: hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp địa phương
gây áp lực lên nhà ở
bảo vệ bản sắc địa phương
chia sẻ lợi ích kinh tế

aid.grammar: Dùng while để nêu lợi ích và tác động trái chiều trong cùng lập luận.
aid.sample: Tourism can support local businesses and create seasonal jobs, especially where visitors buy food, crafts or accommodation. At the same time, a sudden increase in visitor numbers may put pressure on housing, transport and public spaces. Communities can benefit more if planning protects local character and shares economic gains fairly. The impact depends on how tourism is managed and whether residents have a voice in decisions.

part3Questions.q: How can travellers prepare for unexpected delays?

idea: Kiểm tra cập nhật và dự trù khoảng thời gian linh hoạt
Mang theo vật dụng cơ bản và thông tin liên lạc

vocab.vi: kiểm tra thông báo dịch vụ
chuẩn bị lộ trình dự phòng
mang theo vật dụng thiết yếu
chia sẻ giờ đến dự kiến
giữ bình tĩnh và linh hoạt

aid.grammar: Dùng before travelling để tổ chức lời khuyên thành bước chuẩn bị.
aid.sample: Before travelling, people can check service alerts, save a backup route and build a time buffer into important plans. Carrying water, a charger and necessary contact details is sensible for a longer trip. If a delay happens, sharing an updated arrival time helps others adjust. Preparation cannot prevent every disruption, but it can make the experience less stressful and help travellers stay flexible.

part2CueCards.title: A journey with an unexpected delay

part2CueCards.task: Describe a public event that you enjoyed attending.
bullets: where and when it took place
what people could see or do
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain what made the event enjoyable for you.

idea: Chọn hội sách, buổi biểu diễn hoặc sự kiện cộng đồng
Miêu tả một hoạt động bạn tham gia
Nêu điều khiến đám đông tạo cảm giác vui

vocab.vi: chương trình được tổ chức tốt

aid.grammar: Dùng quá khứ đơn kể hoạt động và which made để nối chi tiết với cảm nhận.
aid.sample: A public event I enjoyed was a small open-air arts festival held in a central park last spring. I went with my cousin after seeing a notice at the library. Several local groups performed short music and dance pieces, and there were stalls selling handmade items and snacks. We arrived before sunset, so we had time to browse the stalls and find a place to sit. My favourite part was a performance that combined traditional instruments with a modern rhythm. The musicians explained where the melodies came from, which made the show more meaningful. The crowd was lively but not too large, and families could move around without blocking the paths. Between performances, my cousin and I tried a local dessert and talked to one of the artists about how she made her prints. The event felt well organised, with signs showing the programme and volunteers helping visitors find the different areas. I enjoyed it because it offered a shared experience without feeling formal. I also learned something about the local arts scene that I would not have discovered by staying at home. I would like to attend again if the festival returns next year.

part3Questions.q: Why do cities organise public events?

idea: Tạo cơ hội giao lưu và giới thiệu văn hóa địa phương
Hỗ trợ nghệ sĩ, cửa hàng và hoạt động du lịch

vocab.vi: giới thiệu tài năng địa phương
hỗ trợ tham gia văn hóa
củng cố bản sắc cộng đồng

aid.grammar: Dùng serve as a way to để trình bày nhiều mục đích của sự kiện.
aid.sample: Public events serve as a way to bring residents together and showcase local talent. Festivals can also attract visitors, support nearby businesses and create a lively atmosphere in public spaces. For residents, they provide an accessible chance to take part in cultural activities. The best events strengthen community identity while remaining welcoming to people who may not normally attend formal performances.

part3Questions.q: Should governments spend public money on arts and festivals?

idea: Sự kiện có thể đem lại lợi ích cộng đồng rộng
Ngân sách cần minh bạch và cân bằng với dịch vụ thiết yếu

vocab.vi: chứng minh giá trị cộng đồng
cạnh tranh ngân sách dịch vụ thiết yếu
đánh giá lợi ích công cộng

aid.grammar: Dùng can be justified when để nêu điều kiện cho quyết định ngân sách.
aid.sample: Public cultural funding can be justified when an event is accessible and demonstrates community value. Arts programmes offer opportunities that may not be available through commercial entertainment alone. However, budgets must be transparent and balanced with essential services such as transport and health care. Officials should consider attendance, local participation and long-term impact rather than fund an event simply because it attracts publicity.

part3Questions.q: How can organisers make public events more accessible?

idea: Cung cấp thông tin di chuyển, giờ giấc và lối tiếp cận
Thiết kế giá vé cùng khu vực nghỉ phù hợp nhiều nhóm

vocab.vi: thông tin đi lại rõ ràng
vé vào cửa hợp túi tiền
cơ sở vật chất dễ tiếp cận
lên kế hoạch cho nhu cầu khác nhau

aid.grammar: Dùng organisers can improve access by + V-ing để trình bày giải pháp cụ thể.
aid.sample: Organisers can improve access by providing step-free routes, clear travel information and affordable admission options. Quiet rest areas and accessible facilities can make an event more comfortable for visitors with different needs. They should ask community groups for feedback before finalising the layout. Accessibility is easier to build into the plan from the beginning than to add after people discover a barrier.

part3Questions.q: What role do local traditions play in modern festivals?

idea: Truyền thống tạo sự liên tục giữa thế hệ
Có thể kết hợp hình thức mới nhưng cần tôn trọng nguồn gốc

vocab.vi: truyền phong tục cho người trẻ
tìm hiểu câu chuyện phía sau
tôn trọng nguồn gốc văn hóa

aid.grammar: Dùng can be adapted while still để nói truyền thống thay đổi nhưng vẫn giữ giá trị.
aid.sample: Local traditions can give a modern festival a connection to its history and community. They also create a way for older residents to pass customs to younger people. Organisers may adapt the music or presentation to attract new audiences, while still explaining the tradition's meaning. That balance matters: a festival can change with time without turning cultural elements into decoration with no context.

part2CueCards.title: A community event

part2CueCards.task: Describe a practical problem that you solved.
part2CueCards.conclusion: and explain what you learned from solving it.

idea: Chọn vấn đề vừa sức như sửa bài thuyết trình hoặc sắp lịch nhóm
Kể cách chia vấn đề thành bước nhỏ
Nêu kết quả và điều bạn làm tốt hơn lần sau

vocab.vi: rút kinh nghiệm từ kết quả

aid.grammar: Dùng first, then, finally để sắp xếp các bước và quá khứ đơn cho hành động đã hoàn tất.
aid.sample: A practical problem I solved happened while I was preparing a group presentation for class. Two days before the deadline, we discovered that the slides had different formats and some important information was missing. Everyone had edited a separate copy, so it was difficult to see which version was current. I suggested that we create one shared file and list the missing points before making more changes. First, we agreed on a simple design. Then each person checked one section against the notes from our research. I asked a classmate who knew the presentation software to help me fix the layout, while another group member checked the references. We set a short time limit for each task so the work would not expand unnecessarily. By the evening, the main content was complete and we had time to rehearse together. The final presentation was not perfect, but it was clear and consistent. I learned that we should decide how to share files at the start of a project, rather than wait until a problem appears. I also realised that asking for specific help is more useful than trying to manage every detail alone. Solving the issue felt satisfying because the group stayed calm and everyone contributed to the result.

part3Questions.q: Should children be taught problem-solving skills at school?

idea: Bài tập mở khuyến khích thử nhiều cách
Kỹ năng phân tích có ích ngoài lớp học

vocab.vi: xử lý thử thách từng bước
áp dụng kiến thức vào thực tế

aid.grammar: Dùng should be taught through để giải thích cách tổ chức hoạt động học.
aid.sample: Children should be taught to analyse a situation, consider several options and explain why they chose one. Open-ended tasks let them practise these steps without requiring a single perfect answer. Learning from mistakes is also important, because real problems often need adjustment. These skills are useful beyond school, helping young people apply knowledge in practical decisions and cooperate with others.

part3Questions.q: Is it better to solve difficult problems alone or with a team?

idea: Làm một mình nhanh khi vấn đề có phạm vi rõ
Nhóm có thêm góc nhìn nhưng cần phối hợp

vocab.vi: nhiệm vụ có phạm vi rõ
đưa ra góc nhìn khác nhau

vocab.en: match the method to the problem
vocab.vi: chọn cách làm phù hợp vấn đề

aid.grammar: Dùng whereas để so sánh và kết luận bằng the best method depends on.
aid.sample: Working alone can be efficient when a problem is well defined and one person has the necessary information. A team can bring different perspectives and divide the workload when the challenge is larger. The difficulty is coordinating responsibilities and reaching a shared decision. The best method depends on the problem, so people should choose a team only when collaboration adds value rather than complexity.

part3Questions.q: How can digital tools help people solve everyday problems?

idea: Công cụ giúp tìm thông tin và phối hợp nhanh
Người dùng cần kiểm tra độ chính xác và bảo mật

vocab.vi: tự động hóa việc thường lệ
bảo vệ dữ liệu nhạy cảm
dùng công cụ đúng mục đích

aid.grammar: Dùng can help people + động từ và thêm provided that để nêu điều kiện sử dụng cẩn trọng.
aid.sample: Digital tools can help people find information, compare options and coordinate with others quickly. A map app may suggest another route, while a shared document can keep a team's notes in one place. Users still need to verify important information and protect sensitive data. Technology is most useful when people choose an appropriate tool and understand its limits instead of relying on every result automatically.

part3Questions.q: Why do some people find it difficult to ask for help?

idea: Ngại bị xem là thiếu khả năng
Không biết cần hỏi ai hoặc chưa diễn đạt rõ vấn đề

vocab.vi: mô tả khó khăn rõ ràng
đưa ra hỗ trợ thiết thực
coi việc đặt câu hỏi là bình thường

aid.grammar: Dùng may hesitate because để nêu lý do và managers can make it easier by để đưa giải pháp.
aid.sample: People may hesitate because they fear being judged or want to appear independent. Sometimes they are unsure who has the right knowledge, or they cannot describe the difficulty clearly. Schools and workplaces can make it easier by normalising questions and giving people a trusted contact. Asking for help can be a responsible step, especially when it prevents a small issue from becoming much harder to solve.
